title: Weight distribution of a random linear image is dominated by a Hamming ball
hypotheses_covered: x is a nonzero codeword of length k
G ranges over n×k matrices over α
left side counts matrices with weight(Gx) < d, normalized by |α|^{nk}
right side is |B_{d-1}(0)| over codewords of length n, normalized by |α|^n
